source: IGN / CNIG · MDSnE2.5, normalized building surface model
source_period: First PNOA-LiDAR coverage; individual flight date not verified
method: 60th percentile of positive height-above-ground raster cells centered inside each mapped footprint; require at least3 valid samples and45% positive coverage. OSM height/levels untouched. Small/unmatched buildings retain renderer fallback.
caution: Raster-derived roof-height estimates; not measured facade/eaves heights and not verified current as-built condition.
